features.title: SSE heartbeat vs transport idle timeout — every idle SSE stream died ~10s after its last byte because the 15s keep-alive could never fire inside Bun's 10s window
features.notes: Execute complete 2026-08-13: 4 Phases, 9 tasks, 13 commits from origin/main @ 89909051, 4 sequential batch workers. Root cause measured, not inferred: the SSE keep-alive heartbeat (15s, declared twice as independent literals in logs.ts:347 and events.ts:15) is longer than Bun.serve's 10s transport idle window, so it can never fire on an idle stream. Reproduced at the HTTP layer: 8 frames then SILENT 9.0s then socket drop at 13.6s with hb=0. Both SSE endpoints affected; /api/v1/events hid it because EventSource auto-reconnects. The Plan Challenge Gate (evidence-audit) falsified the spec's central premise: 'the idle window is not configurable' rested on five LISTEN-TIME placements, while Bun exposes a PER-REQUEST server.timeout(request, seconds) at listenHandle.bun.server that was never tried -- re-measured against the real routes, a 60s override moved the drop to exactly 60.0s. The gate's own pivot (drop the heartbeat) was then measured wrong too: the window is finite, so it relocates the drop. 120s window + the shipped 15s heartbeat held both endpoints 180s idle (12 and 11 heartbeats). Shipped fix uses both sides. Also fixed: the enqueue-throw path left the stream open with the sink tail polling into a dead controller for the life of the process; and the web-ui live tail treated a transient network drop as terminal. Independent verification PASS (author != verifier), 21/22 ACs, 6/6 mutations killed; its one gap (AC-07.1 index.ts wiring, code-inspection-only) was reproduced as a SURVIVING mutant and closed by a mutation-proved source-level sensor -- revised to 22/22 ACs and 8/8 mutations, honest denominator 8. Gates: lint 0, type-check 6/6, web-ui 727/0, tools-api 51+8+14+3+2 run one file per invocation. Push/PR authorized in-session; merge is a separate decision and in this repo it is a release decision.
